name: ui.button
description: One wide horizontal blank rectangular button, 8:3 aspect ratio. Dark slate inset face, restrained aged bronze beveled edge, bright upper-left edge, stepped square corners, symmetric left and right. No central ornament. Entire face quiet for later text rendering. Front view axis aligned, transparent outside. Nine-slice compatible straight rails.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE original dark fantasy pixel art UI asset. Thick near-black outlines, bold pixel clusters, high contrast, minimal shading, muted metal and stone. No letters, no words, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no commercial game imitation. One wide horizontal blank rectangular button, 8:3 aspect ratio. Dark slate inset face, restrained aged bronze beveled edge, bright upper-left edge, stepped square corners, symmetric left and right. No central ornament. Entire face quiet for later text rendering. Front view axis aligned, transparent outside. Nine-slice compatible straight rails. Centered with 5 percent transparent outer padding. Genuine transparent background.
